acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Ira talks to Chris Benderev, whose high school years were completely upended by an impromptu thing his teacher said.
acts.credits: By Ira Glass and Chris Benderev

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: For Producer Lilly Sullivan, there’s one story about her parents that defines how she sees them, their family, and their history. She finds out it might be wrong.
acts.title: The World Has Turned and Left Me Here

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc:
For years, Mike Comite has replayed in his head the moment when he and his bandmate blew their shot of making it as musicians. He sets out to uncover how it all went awry.
Julia Nunes’s music is available on Spotify.
acts.credits: By Mike Comite; Produced by Diane Wu; Edited by Phia Bennin

songs.a: Belle Brigade. Covered by Julia Nunes and Mike Comite

acts.title: What’s With These Homies Dissing My Girl?

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Six million Syrians fled the country after the start of its civil war. A few weeks ago, one woman watched from afar as everything in her home country changed forever – again.
acts.credits: By Diane Wu; Produced by Hany Hawasly

songs.a: Weezer. Covered by Mike Comite and Julia Nunes

acts.title: And If You See Her, Tell Her It’s Over Now
